member.name: M:VisionAndProjectionService.Swagger.Api.SystemApi.CoreLaserServiceSendHeartBeat(VisionAndProjectionService.Swagger.Model.ClientIdDto)
member.summary: Sends a heartbeat to Virtek Server; active clients which don't, will have projection paused, then be disconnected. This is only required of active clients (see \"Active/Passive Clients and ClientID\" in Integration Guide) * On first connection of an active client, Virtek Server monitors for periodic heartbeats from the client in liu of any actual commands. * If none are received after 2 minutes, Virtek Server pauses projection for that client but will resume projection if it receives any subsequent heartbeat. * If no heartbeat is received after 30 minutes all session resources for the active client are released as though the Client had disconnected/closed.
member.exception: Thrown when fails to make API call

member.name: M:VisionAndProjectionService.Swagger.Api.IToolOperationApi.CoreLaserServiceOpenTool(VisionAndProjectionService.Swagger.Model.OpenToolDto)
member.remarks: Opens the named Work Order in the specified Work Cell (optional), along with other parameters in the OpenToolDto: <example> { \"ClientInfo\": { \"ClientId\": \"string\", \"OriginatingClientGuid\": \"string\", \"Type\": \"Passive\" }, \"WorkOrderName\": \"string\", \"PartSerial\": \"string\", \"WorkCellName\": \"string\", \"LaserScanned\": true, \"ProjectionViewIsLaserScanned\": true, \"PerformStartupCalibration\": true, \"ProjectorsToExcludeOnStartupCalibration\": [ { \"Serial\": \"string\", \"FirmwareLoadStatusCode\": \"Succeed\", \"FirmwareLoadStatusMessage\": \"string\" } ], \"ResumeProjection\": true, \"SetAllTargetsToCertification\": true, \"ClientConfigurationProfileName\": \"string\" } </example> * **WorkOrderName** - Work Order name is derived from its folder name (this is what is shown in Iris Client) * **PartSerial** - Part Serial Number, Only if EnablePartSerial configurations is set. if the PartSerial Number does not exist a new Part Serial will be created for that work Order * **WorkCellName** - The Work Cell name to use WITH this work order (See \"Work Cells\" in the Iris Administrator Guide). This requires at least one Work Cell to be configured in the local system. All connected projectors will initially be included in the Work Cell. To exclude any of the projectors from the Work Cell, use ProjectorsToExcludeOnStartupCalibration below; if WorkCellName is not specified, perhaps because no Work Cell is defined, changing the projectors used is still to be done through ExcludeProjector. * **LaserScanned** - if `true` attempts an Automatic Alignment/FlashAlign to the Work Order tool once opened. * ProjectionViewIsLaserScanned - not currently used * PerformStartupCalibration - not currently used * ProjectorsToExcludeOnStartupCalibration - a collection of projectors (ClientProjectorInfoDto) that will be excluded from the specified WorkCellName (if any) - as though manually excluded in Iris Client or using /ExcludeProjector - from the Work Order; if no WorkCellName is provided this parameter is ignored. Use projector serial numbers; Familiar or Friendly names are not supported. * ResumeProjection - not currently used (use /PauseProjection and /ResumeProjection) * SetAllTargetsToCertification - not currently used * ClientConfigurationProfileName - An optional parameter. A configuration profile name to identify which configuration profile the server will use to load work order files. Server will use the client baseline default configuration values if this parameter is empty.
member.exception: Thrown when fails to make API call

member.name: M:VisionAndProjectionService.Swagger.Api.IToolOperationApi.CoreLaserServiceOpenToolWithHttpInfo(VisionAndProjectionService.Swagger.Model.OpenToolDto)

member.name: M:VisionAndProjectionService.Swagger.Api.ITransformsApi.CoreLaserServiceRotateProjection(VisionAndProjectionService.Swagger.Model.ClientRotationDto)
member.remarks: Rotates all Work Order projection in the Direction specified (Clockwise, CounterClockwise); same as pressing the \"Rotate Clockwise/Counter-clockwise\" buttons in Iris Client. The fixed rotation amount (in Degrees) is specified as \"Shift Rotation in Degrees\" under Virtek Server: Projection Options in Virtek Server Manager or in Iris Client > Configuration: Projection Options.. Returns the cumulative or net effect of all x/y shifts and rotations that are currently applied to this Work Order. See \"Using the Shift Feature\" in either Iris Operator or Administrator guides for details on how translation information is applied relative to surface geometries.
member.exception: Thrown when fails to make API call

member.name: M:VisionAndProjectionService.Swagger.Api.ITransformsApi.CoreLaserServiceShiftProjection(VisionAndProjectionService.Swagger.Model.ClientShiftingDto)
member.remarks: Translates projection in the corresponding direction (Up/Down/Left/Right); same as pressing the \"Up/Down/Left/Right Shift\" buttons in Iris Client. The fixed shift amount is specified as \"Shift Translation\" in Iris Client: Projection Options as system default in Virtek Server: Projection Options. Returns the cumulative or net effect of all x/y shifts and rotations that are currently applied to this Work Order. Note that in Iris Client or Virtek Server Manager translation amounts are show in Display Units, while here they are listed in feet.
